changelog: 新增貼圖分享物品。可設定貼圖網址，設置在角色身上並分享顯示給其他人
⭐DDT - 繪圖檢測工具 新增
偵測 canvas & DOM 物件的屬性，支持染色與位移，並支持繪製物件功能
以WCE為基底合併幾個小型插件功能，並提供美化登入介面與帳號記憶功能
⭐HSC - 催眠奴隸俱樂部 更新
修正名稱識別障礙失效錯誤
修正編輯他人文本時，顯示不全錯誤
en_changelog: Add sticker item: allows setting a sticker URL, attaching it to a character, and sharing it so that it is visible to others.
Detect properties of canvas & DOM objects, support tinting and displacement, and support object drawing functionality.
Based on WCE, merge several small plugin features, and provide a beautified login interface with account memory functionality.
Fixed display truncation issue when editing others' text.
